Myths on Clay tells the hidden scriptures of Gnosis, book by book, as they are written: the Secret Book of John, the Reality of the Rulers, On the Origin of the World and Pistis Sophia, with clay-style illustrations. The Invisible Spirit is shown only as light.
Sources: The Secret Book of John (Apocryphon of John: Nag Hammadi Codices II, III, IV and the Berlin Codex 8502); The Reality of the Rulers (NHC II,4); On the Origin of the World (NHC II,5); Pistis Sophia (Askew Codex, tr. G. R. S. Mead, 1921).
Narrated by Matías.
